extensionDescription.message: Replaces file pickers with an overlay that also takes images from the clipboard.

actionTitleEnabled.message: FIOverlay is active here - click to disable for this domain

actionTitleDisabled.message: FIOverlay is off here - click to enable for this domain

dropHint.message: Press $1 to insert an image from the clipboard

urlPlaceholder.message: Paste a file or image URL

errorClipboardEmpty.message: No image or file found in the clipboard.

errorClipboardBlocked.message: This page blocks clipboard access - use the keyboard shortcut instead.

errorDownloadFailed.message: The image could not be downloaded.

errorInvalidUrl.message: Only http, https and data URLs can be loaded.

errorTooLarge.message: The file is too large (max. 64 MB).

errorSomeRejected.message: $1 file(s) were skipped because the field does not accept them.

errorAssignFailed.message: The file could not be handed over to the page.

optionsIntro.message: On the domains listed here the native file picker stays untouched. Click the toolbar icon on a page to add or remove its domain. To skip the overlay for a single click, hold Alt (Option) while clicking the file field.

optionsAlreadyListed.message: This domain is already on the list.

optionsBackupHint.message: The list is synced with your browser account. Export writes a JSON file, import merges it into the current list.

optionsImportFailed.message: The file could not be read.
